senses.gloss: सग् €1 P. (सगति) To cover.
सगण a. Attended by troops or flocks.
सगण + .{@-णः@} An epithet of Śiva.
सगतिक a. Connected with a preposition &c.

सगन्ध a.
—1 Fragrant.
—2 Related.
—3 Proud, arrogant.
सगन्ध + .{@-न्धः@} A kinsman, relation, kindred; सर्वः सगन्धेषु विश्वसिति Ś. 5; Me. 9.
सगर a. [गरेण विषेण सहितः] Poisonous, having poison.

सगर + .{@-रः@} N. of a king of the Solar race. [He was a son of Bāhu and
 was called Sagara because he was born together with gara or poison given
 to his mother by the other wife of his father. By his wife Sumati he had 60000
 sons. He successfully performed 99 sacrifices but when he commenced
 the hundredth, his sacrificial horse was stolen by Indra and carried down
 to the Pātāla. Sagara thereupon commanded his 60000 sons to search it
 out. Finding no trace of the animal on earth they began to dig down towards
 the Pātāla, and in doing this they naturally increased the boundaries
 of the ocean which was therefore called Sāgara; cf. R. 13. 3. Meeting
 with the sage Kapila they rashly accused him of having stolen their horse,
 as a punishment for which they were instantly reduced to ashes by that
 sage. It was after several thousands of years that Bhagīratha (q. v.)
 succeeded in bringing down to the Pātāla the celestial river Ganges
 to water and purify their ashes and thus to convey their souls to heaven.]

सागरः [सगरेण निर्वृत्तः अण्]
—1 The ocean, sea; सागरः सागरोपमः; (fig. also); दयासागर,
 विद्यासागर &c.; cf. सगर.
—2 The number ‘four’ or ‘seven’.
—3 A kind of deer.
—4 N. of Bhagīratha; शंकरस्य जटाजूटाद् भ्रष्टां सागरतेजसा Rām. 2. 50. 25.
.━{@Comp.@}: सागरानुकूल, सागरान्त, सागराम्बरा, सागरनेमिः, सागरमेखला, सागरालयः, सागरावर्तः, सागरोत्थम्, सागरगमा, सागरगा, सागरगामिनी, सागरनेमिः, सागरप्लवनम्, सागरमेखला, सागरसुता, सागरसूनुः

सगर्भः, -र्भ्यः
—1 A brother of whole blood; सह तनुजसगर्भप्रेष्यरक्षःसहस्रैः Mv. 6. 27.
—2 Similar to; रत्नावलीश्चौषधिभिः सगर्भाः Bu. C. 2. 21.

सगर्भः, -र्भ्यः
—1 A brother of whole blood; सह तनुजसगर्भप्रेष्यरक्षःसहस्रैः Mv. 6. 27.
—2 Similar to; रत्नावलीश्चौषधिभिः सगर्भाः Bu. C. 2. 21.

सगुण a.
—1 Possessed of qualities or attributes.
—2 Possessed of good qualities, virtuous.
—3 Worldly.
—4 Furnished with a string (as a bow).
—5 Possessed of the qualities in rhetoric.
सगोत्र a. Being of the same family or kin, related.

सगोत्र + .{@-त्रः@}
—1 A kinsman sprung from a common ancestor; तत्रभवतो युष्मत्सगोत्रस्य
 कण्वस्यापराद्धोऽस्मि Ś. 7.
—2 A kinsman of the same family, one connected by funeral oblations of
 food and water.
—3 A distant kinsman.
सगोत्र + .{@-तम्@} Family, race, lineage.
सगोष्ठी Fellowship with; अथेन्द्रियारामसगोष्ठपतृष्णया Bhāg. 4. 22. 23.
सग्धिः f. Eating together.
सागम a. Legitimate.
सागरः + -अनुकूल a. situated along the sea-coast.
सागरः + -अन्त a. bounded by the sea, sea-girt.
सागरः + -अम्बरा, -नेमिः, -मेखला the earth.
सागरः + -अम्बरा, -नेमिः, -मेखला the earth.
सागरः + -नेमिः ({@मी@}) the earth.
सागरः + -अम्बरा, -नेमिः, -मेखला the earth.
सागरः + -मेखला the earth.
सागरः + -आलयः N. of Varuṇa.

सागरः + -आवर्तः an island or bay of the sea; स मया सागरावर्ते दृष्ट
 आसीत् परीप्सता Mb. 3. 14. 19 (com. सागरस्य आसमन्ताद्वर्तो वर्तनं
 यस्मिन् सागरद्वीपे इत्यर्थः)
सागरः + -उत्थम् sea-salt.

सागरः + -गमा, -गा
—1 a river; दिवि वा सागरगमास्तेन वो मानयाम्यहम् Mb. 13. 146. 23.
—2 the Ganges.

सागरः + -गमा, -गा
—1 a river; दिवि वा सागरगमास्तेन वो मानयाम्यहम् Mb. 13. 146. 23.
—2 the Ganges.
सागरः + -गामिनी a river.
सागरः + -प्लवनम् navigating (the ocean).

सागरः + -सुता N. of Lakṣmī; मनोवृत्तिस्तार्क्ष्यो मतिरियमथो सागरसुता
 Viṣṇumahimna 24.
सागरः + -सूनुः the moon.

साग्नि a.
—1 Having fire.
—2 Taking the sacred fire; साग्नयोऽनग्नयश्चेव सशिष्यगणबान्धवाः Mb. 3. 1. 44.

साग्निक a.
—1 Maintaining, or possessing fire.
—2 Attended by fire.
साग्निक + .{@-कः@} A house-holder who maintains the sacred fire.

साग्र a.
—1 Entire; तेषां तु युद्धमानानां साग्रः संवत्सरो गतः Rām. 7. 23. 9.
—2 With a surplus, more than.
साग्र + .{@-ग्रम्@} ind. For a longer period, for a whole life.
